description: This file defines Redux state management for 'cards' in a web application, including actions, selectors, and state structure related to card data, templates, sorting, filtering, and asynchronous updates.

methods.name: refreshCards
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk to refresh card blocks based on a timestamp, fetching relevant blocks from the client.

methods.name: limitCard
methods.description: Helper function to limit card data based on template status and update timestamp.

methods.name: getCard
methods.description: Selector factory to retrieve a specific card or template by ID.

methods.name: titleOrCreatedOrder
methods.description: Function to determine order of cards based on title or creation date.

methods.name: manualOrder
methods.description: Function to determine order of cards based on a manual view order or title/creation date.

methods.name: sortCards
methods.description: Function to sort an array of cards based on view sort options, properties, and last comment update.

methods.name: searchFilterCards
methods.description: Filters cards based on search text matching titles or properties.
